nodes.description: A logic gate that allows electrical passthrough if BOTH inputs receives power, passthrough amount is the greater of either power source
Single module armored cockpit for a driver and one passenger.
Single module armored seating for two passengers.
A speaker which will emit a loud warning alarm when powered

The Auto Turret guards your base by shooting anything moving in the 180 degree arc facing you when you place it, but it needs a projectile weapon, matching ammo and 10 power before it works. Buy one for 400 scrap at [Outpost](/monument/outpost) or a Floating City, or craft it at a tier 2 workbench with a [targeting computer](/items/targeting-computer), [CCTV camera](/items/cctv-camera) and 25 HQM. Breaking one takes 3 HV rockets, 2 C4 or 3 wooden spears.
This object prevents passthrough while power is received through its second input.
A simple electric button.

The Camper Vehicle Module is the Rust RV, a two-slot module that turns a [modular car](/world/modular-car) into a camper van with four seats, respawns for up to 4 players, a barbecue, a [locker](/items/locker) and a 12-slot box. To make one, craft it at a tier 2 workbench from 175 metal frags and 125 wood. Research costs 100 [scrap](/items/scrap), or 10 [blueprint fragments](/items/blueprint-fragment) total on the tech tree after the storage module. A Green Recycler gives back 87 frags and 62 wood, plus a 50% chance at extra of each.
A small ceiling mounted light source.
Single module cockpit for a driver and one passenger.
Single module cockpit for a driver and one passenger, with a small engine.

The Computer Station gives you remote control access, letting you watch CCTV at places like Cargo Ship, [Bandit Camp](/monument/bandit-camp) and [Oil Rig](/monument/oil-rig) using their camera codes. Buy one at [Outpost](/monument/outpost) for 300 scrap. Otherwise craft it at a tier 2 workbench from 5 HQM, a Targeting Computer, an RF Broadcaster and an RF Receiver, with research at 40 scrap or 14 [blueprint fragments](/items/blueprint-fragment) total on the tech tree. Locked and elite crates rarely drop it.
A basic cathode ray tube screen combined with an incremental counter. Can display power received, or can count upwards and allow passthrough when a target is reached.
A digital clock that displays the server time and lets you set alarms to pass power through when ringing. Ideal for synchronizing traps or timed events.
A Door Controller. Will manipulate the state of the closest door when it receives power

A Drone is a remote-controlled flyer you pilot from a [Computer Station](/items/computer-station). Its range is limited and impacts damage it easily. Craft one at a tier 2 workbench for 200 frags and a [CCTV camera](/items/cctv-camera), after researching one for 100 scrap or spending 15 blueprint fragments total on the tech tree. Don't count on finding one: loot is rare, with the best chance 1.56% from [Treasure Mission Boxes](/world/missionlootbox-basic).

The Electric Furnace does the same job as regular [furnaces](/items/furnace) but runs on electricity instead of fuel. It needs 3 rW of power through a single Power In input. Craft it at a tier 2 workbench for 5 HQM and 200 frags after unlocking it in the tech tree (11 blueprint fragments total) or researching one for 40 scrap. It's rare in loot, with the best odds at 1.56% in [treasure mission boxes](/world/missionlootbox-basic) and less in [locked crates](/world/locked-crate).

The Electric Heater keeps you warm in a radius while it's on. A heater takes 3 power, with one input and one passthrough output for wiring. Buy one for 75 scrap at [Outpost](/monument/outpost), or craft it for 200 frags at a tier 1 workbench after researching it for 40 scrap or unlocking it for 6 [blueprint fragments](/items/blueprint-fragment) on the tech tree. Loot drops are rare, 1.11% at best in [Underwater Advanced Crates](/world/crate-underwater-advanced).

The Electrical Branch splits a set amount of power off your main line and lets the rest pass through. Wire power into Power In, then the amount you set leaves through Branch Out and the remainder carries on via Power Out. Craft it for 75 frags at a tier 1 workbench. Research costs 20 [scrap](/items/scrap), or 6 [blueprint fragments](/items/blueprint-fragment) total on the tech tree after the [Splitter](/items/splitter). Normal crates rarely drop it, at about 1.27%.
A powered elevator. Place another elevator above or below this to connect it. Requires power.
Single module large engine.
A flashing blue light
Single module flatbed.
Combines three separate fluid connections into one connection.
Splits a fluid connection into three separate connections.

The fluid switch and pump lets water through or shuts it off, flipped by hand or through its electric Toggle input, and once its Pump Power input is wired it pushes water up to higher entities. Cheapest pickup is 30 scrap at [Outpost](/monument/outpost), [Bandit Camp](/monument/bandit-camp) or the Floating City vendors. Otherwise it's 150 frags at a tier 1 workbench, with research at 20 scrap or 10 [blueprint fragments](/items/blueprint-fragment) total down the tech tree. Loot drops are rare.

The Fridge, or refrigerator, is powered food storage with 48 slots, and it needs 5 rW through its one electric input. Craft it at a tier 1 workbench for 150 frags, after researching one for 20 [scrap](/items/scrap) or spending 11 [blueprint fragments](/items/blueprint-fragment) on the tech tree. Looting one is rare: the best chance is 1.11% from [Underwater Advanced Crates](/world/crate-underwater-advanced), and every other source is under 0.5%.
Dual module large fuel tank.

The HBHF sensor, or heartbeat sensor (heartbeat, breathing, humidity and footstep), is an electrical detector whose passthrough equals the number of humans within 10m. To use it, feed Power In and wire Power Out to whatever it should trigger; it draws 1 rW. Craft it at a tier 2 workbench for 75 frags, research it for 40 [scrap](/items/scrap) or tech tree it after the [button](/items/button) for 9 [blueprint fragments](/items/blueprint-fragment) total. Crate drops are rare.
A high quality carburetor for a combustion engine. Mixes air and fuel to the proper ratio.
A high quality crankshaft for a combustion engine. Converts piston movement into rotational motion.
High quality pistons for a combustion engine. Pistons convert expanding combustion gases into the motion that turns a crankshaft.
High quality spark plugs for a combustion engine. Spark plugs ignite the fuel/air mixture to move the pistons.
High quality poppet valves for a combustion engine. Valves control the intake and exhaust flow.

The Hopper sucks up any dropped items in its radius while powered, and its Industrial Out lets you link it into your industrial setup. It draws 8 rW through Power In and also has an Industrial In. Craft it at a tier 1 workbench for 200 frags and 1 gear. Unlocking costs 20 [scrap](/items/scrap) at a research table, or 16 [blueprint fragments](/items/blueprint-fragment) total on the tech tree past the [Industrial Combiner](/items/industrial-combiner). Crate and scientist drops are rare.

The Igniter lights nearby objects like [furnaces](/items/furnace) and campfires when it gets power, and it only needs 2 rW. Wire your power source into its single Power In input and put it close to whatever you want lit. Craft it for 75 metal frags with no workbench (research is 20 scrap, or 8 [blueprint fragments](/items/blueprint-fragment) total on the tech tree), or buy one at [Outpost](/monument/outpost) for 50 scrap. [Basic crates](/world/crate-basic) rarely drop it, about 5% of the time.
Combines three separate industrial connections into one connection.

The Industrial Conveyor moves items from one container to another, and it only needs 1 rW of power to run. Besides Power In it has Turn On and Turn Off inputs, plus Filter Pass and Filter Fail outputs. Craft it for 75 frags at a tier 1 workbench. Unlock it for 20 [scrap](/items/scrap) at a research table, or 13 [blueprint fragments](/items/blueprint-fragment) total through the tech tree past the [Storage Adaptor](/items/storage-adaptor). Crate and scientist drops are rare.
Attaches to a workbench to allow automated crafting.
Splits an industrial connection into three separate connections.
Dual module large flatbed.

The Large Rechargeable Battery, or large battery, stores power: 24,000 rWm of capacity and up to 100 rW out, so it lasts 240 minutes at full output. It has Power Output and Fully Charged outputs, charges at up to 80% efficiency, needs at least a 5 second charge to discharge, and can be wired in series. Craft it at a tier 2 workbench for 10 HQM and 2 [tech trash](/items/tech-trash), since loot is rare (1.56% at best).

The Large Solar Panel turns sunlight into power, up to 20 rW through one electric output, depending on the sun's intensity and its angle to the panel. Buy one for around 75 scrap at [Outpost](/monument/outpost), or craft it at a tier 1 workbench for 5 HQM and 1 [tech trash](/items/tech-trash) after researching it for 40 scrap. Breaking a solar panel takes 1 C4, 1 rocket, 3 satchels, 4 molotovs or 6 hatchets.

The Large Water Catcher is the big water collector, pulling drinkable water from rain and dew into 50,000 ml of storage you can pipe elsewhere. In rain it makes about 15,000 ml a minute, 7,500 in desert rain, against 68 in fog, 23 in snow and just 8 on clear days. Craft it for 500 wood, 200 frags and 2 [tarps](/items/tarp) at a tier 2 workbench, after 40 [scrap](/items/scrap) at a research table or 11 [blueprint fragments](/items/blueprint-fragment) on the Engineering Workbench tree.
A gate which allows power to flow while a player is in the beam
A low quality carburetor for a combustion engine. Mixes air and fuel to the proper ratio.
A low quality crankshaft for a combustion engine. Converts piston movement into rotational motion.
Low quality pistons for a combustion engine. Pistons convert expanding combustion gases into the motion that turns a crankshaft.
Low quality spark plugs for a combustion engine. Spark plugs ignite the fuel/air mixture to move the pistons.
Low quality poppet valves for a combustion engine. Valves control the intake and exhaust flow.
A medium quality carburetor for a combustion engine. Mixes air and fuel to the proper ratio.
A medium quality crankshaft for a combustion engine. Converts piston movement into rotational motion.
Medium quality pistons for a combustion engine. Pistons convert expanding combustion gases into the motion that turns a crankshaft.
Medium quality spark plugs for a combustion engine. Spark plugs ignite the fuel/air mixture to move the pistons.
Medium quality poppet valves for a combustion engine. Valves control the intake and exhaust flow.

The medium battery stores power, holding 9,000 rWm and putting out up to 50 rW. It charges from whatever feeds Power In at up to 80% efficiency, needs a 5 second minimum charge to discharge, and can be wired in series. There's a Fully Charged output next to Power Output. Buy one at [Bandit Camp](/monument/bandit-camp) for 75 scrap or craft it at a tier 2 workbench for 5 HQM and 1 [tech trash](/items/tech-trash). Breaking one takes 34 explo ammo.

A 1 bit storage component. SET input will set the value to 1 CLEAR input sets the value to 0. Output will provide connected power if value is 1, Inverted output will provide connected power if value is 0. This is also known as a D-Type Flip Flop

Detects metal objects which may otherwise be hidden. When the light flashes, or you hear a beep, aim to search for items. Increase the bar until a flag appears. Dig at the flag with a melee item to reveal what it is. Different areas yield different rewards

The Mini Fridge is for preserving food and keeping items cool, with 18 slots of storage. For power, it draws 2 rW through a single Power In input. Craft it at a tier 1 workbench for 50 frags, and research it for 20 [scrap](/items/scrap) or unlock it for 5 [blueprint fragments](/items/blueprint-fragment) total on the tech tree. Skins are available for it, and a Green Recycler gives back 25 frags.

The Modular Car Lift is how you modify modular vehicles, and it needs 5 rW of power through its Power In input. There's one already placed at [Ferry Terminal](/monument/ferry-terminal) and another at [Junkyard](/monument/junkyard). To get your own, buy it for 150 scrap at [Bandit Camp](/monument/bandit-camp), or research it for 100 scrap and craft it at a tier 2 workbench with 200 frags, 5 HQM and 1 gear. Locked and elite crates drop it too, but rarely.
A logic gate that allows electrical passthrough if EITHER input receives power, passthrough amount is the greater of either power source
Dual module seating.

The Powered Water Purifier turns [salt water](/items/salt-water) into fresh water while powered, and it needs 5 rW to run. It handles 4000 ml of salt water a minute at a 2:1 ratio, with Water In, Power In and Water Out connections. The easiest way to get one is [Outpost](/monument/outpost) for 150 scrap, or craft it at a tier 2 workbench for 300 frags, 20 cloth and 100 wood. Crate drops are rare.
A gate which allows power to flow while a player is standing on it
A CCTV Camera system can be used for realtime surveillance and security when paired with the Computer Station. This camera has pan, tilt, and zoom capability.
This switch will allow passthrough based on a random number. Each time the SET input receives power it will roll true or false to allow passthrough
A reactive target that knocks down when hit, can be reset.
Single module seating for two passengers.
An RF Broadcaster

The RF Pager listens on a set frequency and beeps when it picks up an RF signal, or you can switch it to silent mode. Craft it at a tier 2 workbench for 100 metal frags or buy one from the [Outpost](/monument/outpost) tools vendor for 75 scrap. Research is 20 scrap, or 11 [blueprint fragments](/items/blueprint-fragment) total via the tech tree. It rarely drops from [locked crates](/world/locked-crate) and elite crates, and recycles for 50 frags in a Green Recycler.
An RF Receiver
A hand held RF signal broadcaster. Left click to broadcast. Configurable with right mouse.

This object combines two root electrical sources into a single signal. Helpful for stringing together low energy batteries or solar panels to produce higher power output. Can be wired in series, can not be used with any non energy producing electrical components.
A Large, wide beam, aimable light source.

The Seismic Sensor is a raid alarm. It detects vibrations within a set range and outputs a different power value by explosive: 3 for C4 and rockets, 2 for satchels, 1 for HV rockets. It only needs 1 rW through Power In, with the signal coming out of Power Out. Craft it at a tier 2 workbench for 3 HQM and 1 [tech trash](/items/tech-trash), with the blueprint at 40 [scrap](/items/scrap) to research or 9 [blueprint fragments](/items/blueprint-fragment) on the tech tree.

The Siren Light is a spinning light you wire into a circuit, and it only takes 1 power. To break one, use a rocket, a C4, 3 molotovs or 25 explosive ammo. To get one, craft it for 120 frags at a tier 1 workbench after researching it for 20 [scrap](/items/scrap) or unlocking it for 6 [blueprint fragments](/items/blueprint-fragment) on the tech tree. Loot drops are rare, 1.11% at best in [Underwater Advanced Crates](/world/crate-underwater-advanced).

The Small Generator is a simple power source for your electrical setup, burning Low Grade Fuel from its single fuel slot to put out 40 rW. The easiest way to get one is the Building Supplies shop at [Outpost](/monument/outpost) for 125 scrap, though that price shifts. Crafting takes a tier 2 workbench, 5 HQM and 2 [gears](/items/gears), with the blueprint at 40 scrap to research or 10 [blueprint fragments](/items/blueprint-fragment) total through the tech tree. Locked and elite crates only drop it rarely.

The Small Rechargeable Battery stores power for your electrical setup, holding 400 rWm and putting out up to 15 rW, and you can wire them in series. To unlock it, research one for 20 [scrap](/items/scrap) or go through the Engineering Workbench tech tree, where it sits after the [Large Solar Panel](/items/large-solar-panel) for 4 [blueprint fragments](/items/blueprint-fragment) total. Craft it for 5 HQM at a tier 1 workbench. Normal crates rarely drop it. It needs 5 seconds of charge before it discharges.

The small water catcher is your basic water collector, pulling drinkable water out of the air from rain and dew. The rate swings hard with the weather: about 5,000ml a minute in rain, 23ml in fog and just 3ml on a clear day. It holds 10,000ml and pipes out through Water Out. Craft it at a tier 1 workbench for 100 wood, 50 frags and a [tarp](/items/tarp) after researching it for 20 [scrap](/items/scrap). Crate and scientist drops are rare.
Sends notifications to your phone when powered on.
A smart electric switch.

The Splitter takes one electrical input and splits it across three outputs, with power divided evenly by however many output slots you actually use. Craft it for 100 metal frags at a tier 1 workbench. To unlock it, research one for 20 [scrap](/items/scrap) or go through the tech tree after the [small rechargeable battery](/items/small-rechargeable-battery), 5 [blueprint fragments](/items/blueprint-fragment) total. It rarely drops from normal crates and scientists. Recycles for 50 frags in a Green Recycler.
A small sprinkler that sprays water around it. Requires a hose connection to supply it with water.

The storage adapter attaches to a storage container so it can take industrial lines, with Industrial In and Industrial Out connections. Storage adapters do need power, but only 1 rW each through Power In, and the Passthrough output sends power onward. Craft one at a tier 1 workbench for 100 frags, with research at 20 [scrap](/items/scrap) or 12 [blueprint fragments](/items/blueprint-fragment) total on the tech tree behind the [Electric Furnace](/items/electric-furnace). Crate and scientist drops are rare.
The Storage Monitor attaches to the Tool Cupboard and Large Storage Box to monitor the container contents. Output sends a pulse when the container is updated.
Single module storage.
A simple electric switch.
Single module seating for two passengers, with protection at the front.
Use the telephone to call other telephones on the island!

The Tesla Coil is an electrical trap that zaps nearby players when powered, and more power means more damage. It draws 25 rW through its Power In input and loses durability as it's used. [Outpost](/monument/outpost) sells one for 75 scrap, or craft it at a tier 2 workbench for 3 HQM and 1 [tech trash](/items/tech-trash), with research at 20 scrap or 15 [blueprint fragments](/items/blueprint-fragment) total on the tech tree. Crate drops are rare, under 2%.
A Timer switch, will pass power through for duration.
A storage container for water. Can output 10ml of water a second via a hose.

The Water Pump sits in a water source and collects that water while powered, feeding other water entities. Power usage is 5 rW through its Power In, and the Water Output pushes 510 ml/min. The easy way to get one is 200 scrap at [Outpost](/monument/outpost). Otherwise it's 250 wood, 200 frags and 1 gear at a tier 2 workbench, with research at 40 scrap or 13 [blueprint fragments](/items/blueprint-fragment) total down the tech tree. Crate drops are rare.

The Water Wheel is a generator that turns flowing water into electricity, putting out 30 rW through its single Power Out socket. Craft it at a tier 1 workbench for 500 wood, 2 [gears](/items/gears) and 1 [sheet metal](/items/sheet-metal). Research costs 100 scrap, or it's 2 blueprint fragments total on the Engineering Workbench tech tree, after the [Switch](/items/switch). In a Green Recycler it returns 250 wood and 1 gear, with a 50% chance at sheet metal.

The Wind Turbine, or windmill, turns wind into electricity: up to 150 rW, varying with wind speed, and higher altitudes get stronger wind. Buy one for around 500 scrap at [Bandit Camp](/monument/bandit-camp) or craft it at a tier 2 workbench for 500 wood, 10 HQM, 3 [gears](/items/gears) and 3 [sheet metal](/items/sheet-metal). Loot drops are rare, 1.56% at best. Destroying a windmill takes 1 C4, 2 rockets, 17 HV rockets or 100 explo ammo.

An exclusive-or logic gate that allows electrical passthrough if ONLY ONE input receives power, passthrough amount is whichever single input is active. If BOTH inputs receive power, passthrough will be zero.
